behaviors.description: OCI update listings compare image identities, not imported OSTree commits.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent OCI app A/B and runtime layouts served by a local registry; two remote names share its refs, only one is the installed origin.
behaviors.expected: Empty listing after install, exactly the changed app after publication, no cross-origin update, and empty listing after applying B; independent execution changes A to B.

surface_assertions.rationale: OCI publication and installation transitions determine the exact listed update set, with an origin-filter control.

mappings.rationale: Focused OCI identity regression; no new requirement denominator.
